objective: Make a future participant, session, device, article, and optional multi-view validation plan mechanically auditable before any real collection or outcome inspection.
threats: the same participant appearing in development and confirmation
sessions or paired sensor artifacts from one physical capture crossing analysis roles
the same article or near-duplicate article family crossing analysis roles
claiming device generalization while reusing one physical device across roles
claiming multi-view benefit without paired timestamps, declared synchronization tolerance, relative-camera calibration, or missing-view behavior
adding observed answers, scores, gaze errors, predictions, or reading outcomes to the planning artifact
echoing pseudonymous identifiers in aggregate audit output
treating engineering readiness as authorization to recruit participants

multi_view_requires: at least two distinct source roles per capture run

decision_rule.pass: Retain the tooling as an engineering prerequisite. It does not authorize recruitment, export a dataset, or establish model effectiveness.
decision_rule.fail: Preserve the failure and keep participant collection and dataset export locked until a separately reviewed v2 contract passes.

columbia_gaze.use_boundary: Potential independent stress test only after a separate frozen label-convention and preprocessing protocol.

eth_xgaze.use_boundary: Do not request or download automatically.

gaze_capture.use_boundary: Do not download before a separate storage, license, and preprocessing review.

eyediap.use_boundary: Do not treat as immediately available.
